raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Register `test_unified_handout_zeroing.py` in `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd`.

The test exercises the unified allocator and page-zeroing kernels on device memory. On AMD this lowers through ROCm Triton, covering backend-specific code generation and launch behavior while checking that fresh and recycled page envelopes are zeroed.

The AMD small suite grows from 108 to 109 effective entries (+9 estimated GPU-seconds).

## Test plan

- [x] Registration lint and CI AST collector with `sanity_check=True`
- [x] ROCm 10 AMD CI: both tests in `test_unified_handout_zeroing.py` passed; partition 3 finished 7/7 ([job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35676914989/job/106591250706))
- [ ] ROCm 7.2.4 and 7.2.0 have not run
- [ ] NVIDIA Base CI did not complete; the current run was canceled ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35676915009))

The overall AMD run also has an unrelated MI35x failure in `test_quark_mxfp4.py`: GSM8K accuracy was 0.826, below the required 0.85 ([job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35676914989/job/106591250362)).
